gen-gf-imbue-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa sprawls wide and friendly, its stubby ascenders tucked under a big x-height. Imbue sits against it as the bookish one, tightly packed and literary, so the sans feels like a bright window next to a leather-bound spine.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga spaces its flat, single-weight letters out so each word gets room to breathe. And Imbue, with its moderate stroke contrast, would give a long read a bookish flicker, while the plain sans keeps the pace unhurried.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with a single nib, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals and every c visibly gapped. Imbue brings the reed-pen curves; Mega brings arches that match their stems.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-lexend-peta: Imbue packs its letters tight, with horizontals a touch slimmer than the verticals and a literary hush. Lexend Peta, a plain sans, keeps its width through every turn, so the heading earns its keep when set big and brief.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-lexend-tera: Imbue sets editorial, tightly fitted letters where even the thinnest strokes stay sturdy and the thickest stay restrained. Lexend Tera scatters its plotter-pen sans letters like stepping stones beneath.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-montserrat-alternates: Literary and snug, Imbue narrows gradually from stem to terminal, leaving hardly any white between its shapes. And Montserrat Alternates, a plain sans, keeps one stroke width throughout, so a long passage would feel crisp and chalk-board direct.
gen-gf-jaini-gf-graduate: Jostling, towering letters crowd together like logs in a river boom. Graduate, a text serif, steps in with generous spacing and a dignified, bookish hush that lets the heading roar.
gen-gf-jaini-purva-gf-graduate: Bold, puzzle-piece letters lock together in one thickness, with barely any step from capitals to lowercase. Graduate, a serif with generous spacing and no stem contrast, would make a long passage feel dignified and unhurried.
gen-gf-joti-one-gf-graduate: Those tiny cracks of openings in every rounded e give Joti One a closed, commanding look. Graduate, a serif, answers with open, generously spaced letters, so a long passage would feel dignified and bookish.
gen-gf-judson-gf-cascadia-code: Judson's oversized lowercase and hairlines that nearly vanish give it a sharp, bookish edge. But Cascadia Code, a plain sans, holds one wire-like width, spacing its letters well apart for a smooth, steady line.
